mapper.sql: SELECT p.policy_id, p.policy_no, p.policy_name, p.price_type, p.customer_id, p.customer_level, p.material_id, p.unit_price, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.customer_name, wms_m.material_name FROM mk_price_policy p LEFT JOIN mk_customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN wms_material wms_m ON p.material_id = wms_m.material_id
mapper.select: WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND p.price_type = '1' AND p.customer_id = #{customerId} AND p.material_id = #{materialId} AND p.start_date <= CURDATE() AND p.end_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY p.policy_id DESC LIMIT 1

WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND p.price_type = '2' AND p.customer_level = #{customerLevel} AND p.material_id = #{materialId} AND p.start_date <= CURDATE() AND p.end_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY p.policy_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_price_policy (policy_no, policy_name, price_type, customer_id, customer_level, material_id, unit_price, start_date, end_date, status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{policyNo}, #{policyName}, #{priceType}, #{customerId}, #{customerLevel}, #{materialId}, #{unitPrice}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
